products_kind_check.name: products_kind_check
products_kind_check.value:
("app"."products"."kind" = 'game' and "app"."products"."game_id" is not null and "app"."products"."slot" is null and not "app"."products"."consumable" and "app"."products"."grant_coins" is null)
       or ("app"."products"."kind" = 'item' and "app"."products"."game_id" is not null and "app"."products"."slot" is not null and not "app"."products"."consumable" and "app"."products"."grant_coins" is null)
       or ("app"."products"."kind" = 'coin_pack' and "app"."products"."game_id" is null and "app"."products"."slot" is null and "app"."products"."consumable" and "app"."products"."grant_coins" is not null and "app"."products"."grant_coins" > 0)

orders_completed_at_check.name: orders_completed_at_check
orders_completed_at_check.value: "app"."orders"."status" not in ('completed', 'refunded') or "app"."orders"."completed_at" is not null
